scientific_objective: Generalization of log_SF_A_over_B to unseen extractants with one extractant vote regardless of pair-row count.

reproducibility_environment.run_validation: Every run records exact software and implementation SHA-256 contracts; aggregation fails when they differ.

splits.champion_scoring_runs: the five split_seeds with primary_model_seed only; confirmation seeds are secondary and never give split 104729 extra leaderboard weight
splits.invariant: No extractant may occur in train and validation/test in any inner or outer fold.

metrics.pooled_guardrail: Pooled MAE and R2 are row-weighted descriptive statistics and are never used for model or champion selection.

h1.baseline_estimator: the existing antisymmetric ExtraTrees A2 implementation and frozen inner grid
h1.candidate_family: antisymmetric CatBoost on the exact A2 columns
h1.weight_scope: Counts are computed from the current fit subset only; weights are normalized to mean 1 before pair-swap augmentation.
h1.search_strategy: Within each outer-training split, screen all nine weighting-loss arms with two anchor configurations; then evaluate two expanded configurations only for the three best screening arms. All ranking uses the shared inner folds and equal-extractant macro MAE.

h2.stage1: Best H1 A2 arm selected using outer-training inner-CV equal-extractant macro MAE.
h2.residual_definition: r_i = y_i - stage1_oof_i; an in-sample Stage-1 prediction is forbidden.

feature_views.compact_physics: for each of seven available complex electronic quantities: A-B, abs(A-B), and (A+B)/2

h2.shuffle_scope: current correction-head training subset only; complete E3 vectors move together within pair_label; validation/test features and labels are untouched
h2.acceptance_rule: A residual arm is eligible only when nested CV selects lambda > 0 in at least half of outer folds in at least four of five primary split-seed runs.

h3.architecture: one shared scalar MLP g; prediction = g(ligand_2D, conditions, Ln_A[, electronic_A]) - g(ligand_2D, conditions, Ln_B[, electronic_B])
h3.loss: weighted pseudo-Huber with group_equal fold-local weights
mathematical_assertions: for identical ligand and conditions, prediction(A,B) + prediction(B,C) = prediction(A,C)
h3.label_shuffle_scope: current outer-training targets only, permuted within pair_label; outer-test labels are untouched and are never used for fitting or selection
h3.label_shuffle_rule: Each control reuses the hyperparameters selected by the corresponding real H3 arm and the same final-fit model seed; shuffled labels cannot influence hyperparameter selection. Controls are computed prospectively but become an eligibility gate only if the real H3 arm passes the primary multi-split win rule.

statistics.bootstrap_multiplicity: An extractant sampled k times contributes k independent equal-weight group entries; repeated labels must not collapse in groupby.

decision_rules.champion_score: mean equal_extractant_macro_mae across the five primary split-seed runs, one split seed one vote
decision_rules.win_rule: score lower than A2_current_champion and positive paired delta in at least four of five split seeds
decision_rules.e3_informative_rule: real candidate passes win_rule, beats its shuffled control, and has positive real-vs-baseline direction in at least four of five split seeds
decision_rules.negative_result: If no eligible arm passes win_rule, retain A2_current_champion and report a valid negative result.
